sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r6/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row #24, Internal Quality Checks row #24 (legacy reward.toml wording, superseded by staged layout), Deterministic Checks check-rubric-schema.py, check-scoring-policy.py, check-verifier-contract.py, check-required-files.py
evidence: Source-verified (tomllib parse in memory of frozen .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r6/task/tests). scoring.toml:1-11 has [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; [weights] functional=0.6, polish=0.2, visual=0.2 (sum 1.0); [floors] functional=0.05; every name maps to tests/gates/<name> or tests/scored/<name>, all five exist with judge.toml+prompt.md. Each judge.toml [judge] block (judge="claude-code", mode="batched", isolated=false, prompt_template="prompt.md", timeouts 600/600/9000/900/900) plus its mcp_servers block is identical, via diff up to [scoring], to the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/<suite>/<dim>/judge.toml; no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight keys in [judge]. All five declare playwright (stdio, playwright-mcp, --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --no-sandbox). Only scored/functional/judge.toml:14-18 declares verifier server: /usr/local/bin/python3 [/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, $APP_RESTART_HELPER]; tests/test.sh:193 exports APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh" after heredoc+sed generation and chmod 755 (lines 183-191), before run_suite gates/scored (lines 203-227). test.sh, tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, Dockerfile, .dockerignore are byte-identical to the frozen template (cmp). Criteria: render 1 (hro_gate_render) and constraints 1 (hro_gate_shared), both binary weight 1.0 with aggregation all_pass; functional 43 binary, weighted_mean, weights 0.5-2.5 all positive, ids unique; polish 5 binary, weighted_mean; visual 5 likert points=5, weighted_mean. All ids unique per file, all descriptions non-empty, all types binary/likert, no stray top-level tables. Prompts resolve: each prompt.md exists beside its judge.toml, contains exactly one {app_context} (line 3) and one {criteria} (render/constraints 13, functional 55, polish 20, visual 18) and opens http://localhost:3000; no other {..} placeholders in prompts or app_context.md that a format-style substitution could choke on; test.sh:196-201 substitutes {app_context} from tests/app_context.md into /tests/*/*/prompt.md. Functional prompt lines 1 and 51 direct the judge to the restart_app tool once and forbid shell. No CRLF in any judge.toml. task.toml quotes no criterion count to drift. Adversarial: a plausible broken wiring (restart server on polish, unexported helper, likert in a gate, prompt lacking {criteria}, weight in [judge]) is absent; a conforming alternative app is unaffected because wiring is app-independent. Limits: RewardKit was not run against these files in this round; the raw-evidence-index scope states full configured grading is absent, so actual judge loading/MCP launch is unmeasured (structure equals the shared template, so the structural row itself does not depend on that measurement; runtime grading belongs to other rows).
